component.name: StreamMatrix
component.summary: High-performance video matrix viewer for live RTSP camera feeds

description.p: StreamMatrix is a lightweight, high-performance video matrix application designed for viewing and monitoring multiple live RTSP, RTMP, and HTTP video streams simultaneously.

ul.li: Optimized real-time H.264 decoding with multi-threaded slice acceleration
Customizable grid layouts with digital pan/zoom and preset cycling
Dual-profile sub-stream switching for low-bandwidth multi-camera monitoring
Automated reconnection watchdog for dropped or stalled feeds
Live stream diagnostics HUD (FPS, resolution, bitrate, codec)
Native Wayland and X11 display server support

description.p: RTSP streaming stability improvements, non-blocking queue ring-buffer, multi-threaded NEON decoding, and reconnect watchdog.
